title: [IMP-30] DM-specific gaps: relay hints, consent signal, descriptor bootstrap
description: Review finding IMP-30: DM-specific gaps: relay hints, consent signal, descriptor bootstrap (lens IMP). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:151, :153, :159; spec/02-identity.md:37, :302; spec/10-relays.md:612. Fix: Raised to P1 because DM chain registration has no rule at all. Relays admit only chains registered by a CO billing DID under a RelayServiceAgreement (10:612, Q6, S7), and DMs have no CO (04:125, 04:168). As written, no DM envelope passes relay admission, and implementers will each invent a different workaround. The relay-hint contradiction is confirmed: 04:151/153 rely on "DID document relay hints", while 02:37 and 02:302 forbid naming any relay. `consentModel` and the "explicit approval signal" (04:159) have no schema. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
